sentences.text: I cannot guarantee in writing that the Reserve Bank of India will never penalize you, because no evidence here provides a non-penalty guarantee from the Reserve Bank of India. [E1][E2][E3]
The loan agreement in force says a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding applies on pre-payment or foreclosure. [E1][E2][E3]

The earlier Reserve Bank of India pre-payment charge directions cited here are no longer in force on the as-of date, and the applicable UCB rule here says that in cases other than the specific prohibited cases, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB. [R1][R4][R9]

missing.searched: Looked for evidence of a written RBI guarantee that no penalty will ever be imposed if the answer is followed; none was provided.
